'''2007 Worlds Team PMJ DS You Cannot Hide Forever''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[PMJ]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Player name PMJ as on sheet. Line 58 blank; second Cloud City Occupation for 60.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[PMJ]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Cannot Hide Forever / Mobilization Points|You Cannot Hide Forever]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
